row:
I am Ben Stone, a massage therapist specializing in deep tissue massage and practicing for over 20 years.

My purpose is to share what I have learned through my career as a massage therapist in hopes of inspiring and educating others.

Many Massage Therapists share struggles beyond technique. I want to share things I have learned over the years that may help you on your massage career journey. 

I am new to creating and editing video, and I recognize that my videos are in need of improvement, but that is why I am starting this channel. I need to start somewhere. If you like what you see please leave a comment. Subscribing to the channel is also a great form of encouragement!
